label: PF Backlog 141
title: Discovery: agents produce ALL recommendations in one shot from full project context
body:
Instead of per-question round-trips, the discovery agents produce recommendations for every question at once by reading the project + related context/other questions; the user then reviews and only changes what is needed. Faster and gives details the user may not know. API-first.
API-FIRST: expose via backend API.

CLI/BACKEND FLOW (owner): do not ask the panel one-by-one. Generate all questions + recommendations at once, then write a SINGLE review file (id / question / recommendation / current answer) for the whole set; the human reviews, edits, or replies and returns the answers to the pipeline, which records them (record_answers) and proceeds. A .txt/.md/.json review file is acceptable. This replaces the per-question loop in PipelineExecutor._ask_panel (core/pipeline_executor.py:2568). Dashboard counterpart: BI-0126.
_note: PipelineExecutor._ask_panel now writes ONE review file (discovery-review.md: id/question/recommendation/answer for all questions), asks the human once, then parses answers back (discovery_panel.emit_review_file/parse_review_file). Legacy per-question loop kept behind PIPELINE_PANEL_ONE_BY_ONE=1. Round-trip verified 90/90 + edit path.
